senses.gloss:
दल् दल् (akin to दॄ), i. 1, Par. To burst, Lass. 66, 15.
 --Caus. दा̆लय, To cause to burst, Suśr. 1, 262, 9, दलित,
 1. Burst, MBh. 8, 4633.
 2. Split, wounded, Prab. 87, 13.
 3. Destroyed, Prab. 116, 6.
 4. Visible, Prab. 40, 10.
 --With the prep. अव अव, To burst, Suśr. 2, 166, 6.
 --With उद् उद्, Caus. To divide, MBh. 12, 7349.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To burst, Naiṣ. 4, 88.
 2. To rend, Rām. 2, 87, 10 Gorr. विदलित, Crushed, Bhartṛ. 2, 77.
 --With सम् सम्, संदलित, Pierced, Lass. 73, 12.
 --Cf. दॄ.

दल दल् + अ,
 I. n. A part, Suśr. 2, 357, 4 (अण्ड-, an egg-shell; वेणु-, a small shoot of a cane, Man. 8, 299).
 2. A half, Suśr. 1, 25, 2.
 3. A leaf, Rām. 2, 46, 14.
 II. m. A proper name, MBh. 3, 13178.
 --Comp.

दलन दल् + अन,
 I. adj., f. नी, Tearing, Bhāg. P. 7, 10, 59.
 II. n. Breaking, crushing, Gīt. 5, 2; Rājat. 3, 284.
दालन दालन, i. e. दल् + अन, n. Crumbling off (of the teeth), Suśr. 2, 132, 12.
दलशस् दल + शस्, adv. In pieces, Kathās. 19, 109.
दाल्भ्य दाल्भ्य, i. e. दल्भ, the name of a Ṛṣi, + य, patronym. A descendant of Dalbha, MBh. 2, 106.
